prompt: Fix the buggy `WorkflowOrchestrator` in `orchestrator.py`. It manages tasks with dependencies under a global token cap. Read the class and method docstrings in the file for the exact state-machine, token-accounting, cancellation and ordering contract — the prompt is intentionally brief. Implementations must be functionally correct and `get_runnable_tasks()` must be efficient (must not re-scan dependencies on each call). Do not change the public API.
title: Token-Gated Workflow Orchestrator
